abilities.description: You always add +1 to negotiation, and +1 to hide. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.8d9830fb825057b0]{Check Your Gear}, you may preset your action die to four. You also start with a strong bond with someone, an ally non-player character (NPC) that will give you +1 whenever you make a move with their help, and +2 whenever they help you with their specialty, and you take +1 momentum on a hit. You may start with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.11de92d262291440]{Scavenger} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.f64df27e8f9083bd]{Trader} asset for free (you still get your usual starting assets).
